update_cadence.supply: annual USGS MCS PGM chapter + company quarterlies; no reliable public monthly world mine series

overall_rationale: USGS MCS 2026 (Feb): world palladium mine output 190,000 kg (2025e), Russia 84,000 kg (~44%) + South Africa 70,000 kg (~37%) = ~81% — the structural two-country choke. Oct 2026 brief: (1) Sibanye-Stillwater Stillwater East + Columbus USW strike (from 3 Sep) ENDED — new 3-yr CBA ratified, SENS 7 Oct 2026, staff back on day shift 9 Oct; East Boulder CBA finalised ~29–30 Sep. US primary node de-escalated from red to green (restart ramp + Montana costs still watched). (2) New US trade friction: Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act signed 18 Sep 2026 — Sec. 112 requires duties 'up to 500%' on all Russian-origin imports within 30 days (~18–19 Oct 2026), no minimum rate, broad presidential waiver; not palladium-specific and rate/implementation pending. Separate from the closed AD/CVD case (USITC 29 May 2026 negative; no orders). SFA/Heraeus (Sep 2026) notes Russian Pd imports into the US had already stopped. (3) Nornickel: H1 2026 Pd 1,199 koz (−14% YoY) on lower-grade feed; FY2026 guidance 2,415–2,465 koz reiterated 27 Jul. From Jul 2026 all Nornickel Pd concentrate is produced at Kola MMC (Monchegorsk) — a single-node concentration (~40% of world Pd per plant technologist); drone-risk commentary only, no reported strike/outage. (4) SA: no belt-wide strike or load-shedding crisis; Sibanye Kwezi shaft (Rustenburg) in s189A consultations (~1,114 jobs, reserve depletion) — small, yellow. Valterra FY guidance 3.0–3.4 Moz PGM unchanged; Implats FY27 refined guidance 3.30–3.50 Moz 6E. Balance/demand: JM (May 2026) sees ~214 koz 2026 Pd surplus; SFA/Heraeus (Sep 2026) sees 345 koz deficit (primary 5.91 Moz −4%, recycling 3.01 Moz +7%, gross demand 9.27 Moz −2%). Price at ~1-yr lows in early Oct on weak ICE/hybrid auto demand. Posture stays Watch (RU+SA concentration; Nornickel lower run-rate + Kola single-node; new US Russia-tariff mandate pending), not Stress (no multi-week Norilsk/Kola halt, no simultaneous RU+SA disruption, no Western physical embargo with offtake blocked). Normal not yet: Sec. 112 is a fresh trade-friction escalation and Nornickel 2026 output is ~10% lower.

US: Stillwater/East Boulder (Montana) domestic feed + heavy import reliance; Stillwater East + Columbus strike 3 Sep–7 Oct 2026 resolved (return 9 Oct). Secondary: spent autocatalysts → collectors → PGM refiners.

baseline_signals.title: Stillwater East + Columbus strike ends: USW ratifies 3-yr CBA; return to work 9 Oct
baseline_signals.summary: SENS 7 Oct 2026: new CBA effective 1 Jun 2026–31 May 2029 (4.5% yr1; ≥3.5%/CPI yr2; ≥3.0%/CPI yr3) closes the strike running since 3 Sep 2026; employees resume day shift Fri 9 Oct 2026. East Boulder CBA finalised ~29–30 Sep without a strike. ~420 workers covered (Montana Free Press). Watch restart ramp and Montana cost pressure (H1 AISC cited ~$1,347/2E oz by trade press).

baseline_signals.title: US Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act signed: Sec. 112 'up to 500%' duties on all Russian imports due ~18–19 Oct
baseline_signals.summary: Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026 signed 18 Sep 2026. Sec. 112 directs the President, within 30 days, to raise duties on all goods from Russia to a rate of up to 500% ad valorem (no minimum; cumulative; broad Sec. 115 waiver). Not palladium-specific; rate and scope pending implementation. Separate from closed AD/CVD case. Russian Pd flows to the US had reportedly already stopped (SFA/Heraeus Sep 2026), so near-term physical impact is limited; watch for Pd carve-outs/waivers and any EU/UK follow-on.

baseline_signals.title: Nornickel moves all Pd-concentrate production to Kola MMC (Monchegorsk) from Jul 2026
baseline_signals.summary: Processing of copper anode slime calcine shifted from Norilsk Copper Plant to Kola MMC; plant technologist says the site now accounts for ~40% of global Pd production (Barents Observer/ArcticToday). Efficiency gain, but a single-node choke within the P0 producer. Drone-risk commentary exists; no reported attack or outage as of mid-Oct 2026.

baseline_signals.title: Sibanye-Stillwater opens s189A consultations on Rustenburg Kwezi shaft (~1,114 jobs)
baseline_signals.summary: Kwezi shaft at limits of approved mining licence area / end of economic life; ~781 employees + 333 contractors potentially affected; Kwezi Shallows project delayed by objections/appeals. Small vs SA belt; a reserve-depletion yellow, not a strike.

baseline_signals.title: SFA/Heraeus Palladium Standard: 2026 Pd deficit 345 koz; primary 5.91 Moz (−4%), recycling 3.01 Moz (+7%)
baseline_signals.summary: Russia 2,465 koz (−10%) on lower-grade feed; SA 2,205 koz; North America 555 koz. Gross demand 9.27 Moz (−2%); light-vehicle production ~92M (−~1M) on Middle East war + weak China; catalysed LVs ~75M. Price forecast $1,100–1,600/oz (avg $1,455) next six months. Contrasts with JM May 2026 ~214 koz surplus — balance is near-flat either way.

baseline_signals.title: Nornickel H1 2026 Pd 1,199 koz (−14% YoY) on lower-grade feed; FY guidance held
baseline_signals.summary: Company release 27 Jul 2026: H1 palladium 1,199 koz (−14% YoY); Q2 590 koz (−3% QoQ), Q1 608 koz. Decline from feedstock metal composition / lower grades. FY2026 guidance reiterated 2,415–2,465 koz Pd. Separate notes: Nadezhda furnace rebuild planned ~2027 (~270 days / ~half capacity).

baseline_signals.title: USGS MCS 2026: Russia 84 + SA 70 of 190 thousand kg Pd world (2025e)
baseline_signals.summary: Two-country mine concentration ~81%. US mine Pd fell to 6,200 kg (Stillwater restructuring). US net import reliance 57%. Global scrap recovery ~140,000 kg Pd+Pt; US autocat ~50,000 kg Pd.

baseline_signals.title: USITC negative: no AD/CVD orders on Russian unwrought palladium (Commerce margins moot)
baseline_signals.summary: Commerce finalized AD 132.83% (Apr 2026) and CVD 109.1% (May 2026), but USITC 29 May 2026 found no material injury/threat (Inv. 701-TA-776 / 731-TA-1761). Commerce will not issue duty orders. Petition (Sibanye-Stillwater + USW, Jul 2025) is closed without permanent US exclusion.

baseline_signals.title: Nornickel FY2025: 2,725 koz palladium (−1% YoY); 2026 guidance lower on feedstock grades
baseline_signals.summary: Company: palladium 2,725 koz from own Russian feed; disseminated ores share rose (lower grades). Market review later cited possible 2026 surplus if recycling/demand softens.

baseline_signals.title: Sibanye-Stillwater cuts Montana PGM output; Stillwater West on care-and-maintenance
baseline_signals.summary: Company restructuring amid weak PGM basket: up to ~45% Montana cut, ~700 jobs, Stillwater West C&M. USGS MCS 2026 US Pd mine 6,200 kg (2025e) vs 10,200 kg (2024).

baseline_signals.title: USGS: SA PGM output down on prices, deep-level costs, electricity disruptions
baseline_signals.summary: MCS 2026 events: SA estimated PGM production −9% in 2025e; Russia −6% on grades/recovery and equipment. Structural SA load-shedding / power risk remains a yellow flag for Bushveld Pd.

baseline_signals.title: USGS: ~50,000 kg Pd recovered from US autocatalysts in 2025
baseline_signals.summary: Secondary supply is a real swing: MCS cites ~140,000 kg Pd+Pt global scrap recovery in 2025. High prices accelerate collection; BEV penetration is a longer-term demand headwind for primary autocat Pd.

sites.name: Nornickel — Norilsk / Talnakh + Kola MMC Monchegorsk (Russia)
sites.share_approx: ~44% of world mine Pd 2025e (USGS Russia 84 of 190 thousand kg)
sites.metric: USGS Russia 84,000 kg (2025e). Company FY2025: 2,725 koz Pd (~84.8 t). Dominant single-producer choke.
watch: Kola MMC Monchegorsk (sole Pd-concentrate node since Jul 2026)
sites.notes: Largest single palladium producer. FY2026 guidance 2,415–2,465 koz (vs 2,725 koz 2025). Since Jul 2026 all Pd concentrate is produced at Kola MMC — a single-node choke. Western buyers face sanctions/tariff friction; metal still sets global availability via non-US destinations.

sites.name: Valterra Platinum (ex-Anglo American Platinum / Amplats) — Bushveld Complex (South Africa)
sites.share_approx: Largest SA PGM producer; SA country total ~37% world Pd (USGS 70,000 kg 2025e)
sites.metric: Country-level USGS only. Company reports 6E/4E ounces — convert to Pd carefully.
sites.notes: With Impala and Sibanye SA, forms the Bushveld belt that is the #2 country choke after Russia.

sites.name: Impala Platinum + Sibanye-Stillwater SA (Rustenburg / Marikana / Kroondal)
sites.share_approx: Part of SA ~37% world; collectively material with Amplats
sites.metric: USGS SA country total 70,000 kg Pd (2025e). No official USGS company split.
sites.notes: Labor and power are the recurring yellow→red escalators for SA Pd.

sites.name: Sibanye-Stillwater — Stillwater & East Boulder (Montana, US)
sites.share_approx: Only primary US PGM mines; USGS US 6,200 kg Pd (2025e) ~3% world
sites.metric: Pd-dominant J-M Reef (~3.5:1 Pd:Pt). 2024–25 restructuring cut Montana output sharply.
sites.notes: Small vs Norilsk/SA but the sole US primary Pd source and only domestic PGM smelter/refinery. Stillwater East + Columbus strike 3 Sep–7 Oct 2026 resolved with 3-yr CBA; East Boulder CBA finalised end-Sep.

sites.name: Zimbabwe — Zimplats / Mimosa / Unki (Great Dyke)
sites.metric: Country total only in MCS. Growing but secondary to RU/SA.
sites.notes: Useful diversification narrative; not a substitute for Norilsk scale.

sites.name: Canada — Sudbury by-product + Impala Canada Lac des Iles
sites.metric: Lac des Iles nearing end-of-life (trade press ~mid-2027); Sudbury Ni ops are by-product Pd.
sites.notes: Important for North American offtake geography; watch LDI wind-down.

sites.name: Secondary — spent autocatalyst recycling (global / US)
sites.share_approx: USGS: ~50,000 kg Pd from US autocats in 2025; ~140,000 kg Pd+Pt global scrap
sites.metric: Secondary is the main swing vs primary mine cuts when prices are high.
sites.notes: Not in the mine table. High Pd prices accelerate recovery; treat promotional recycling tonnes carefully.

sites.share_approx: Development / recovery — not near-term Norilsk substitutes
sites.metric: Nornickel market notes cite Chernogorskoye offtake potential; Sibanye aims higher Montana 2E longer-term if prices hold.
